## About Me

I am a Python developer and data analyst with a growing focus on data science and machine learning.
I currently work as a contractor with Anaconda, contributing to open-source Python projects with an
emphasis on data analysis and visualization.

I previously completed an Outreachy internship with the Bokeh team, where I recreated complex
visualizations from Claus O. Wilke's *Fundamentals of Data Visualization*, documenting my approach
through technical blog posts and translating theory into practical, reproducible workflows.

Before transitioning into tech, I worked as a pharmacist for over seven years, managing clinical
operations, inventory, and patient care. That background sharpened my analytical thinking and
ability to solve real-world problems under pressure — skills I carry directly into data work.
